messages:
Alex: Hey team — CI is red on main, shard-7 failing consistently after the image bump merge (last green commit a1b2c3d4). Anyone available to bisect? :eyes:

CI-bot: Build 1815001200 failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1815001200
Failed tests: tests/kernel/allocator_test.py::test_shrink, tests/runtime/kv_cache_test.py::test_prefetch
Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/1815001200/logs.tar.gz

Mira: I suspect the docker base-tag change from PR #5123 landed in that window. Could be an image vs libc mismatch.

Alex: Last green on main was a1b2c3d4 (Mon 2026-03-01 09:12). First failing build appears at b3d4e5f6 (Tue 2026-03-02 11:05). @Jon can you take a look when you have a sec?

Jon: On it. I'll try to reproduce locally and then run a git-bisect. Any known flaky flags for shard-7? :hammer:

CI-bot: Rerun requested by @Jon: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1815001300 (queued)

Paula: If this is infra/image related we should plan an immediate revert of the image tag change. Alternatively we can pin the failing job to the previous image until we confirm.

Jon: Starting bisect now. Commands I'm running locally:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git bisect start HEAD a1b2c3d4
# run the shard-7 test harness
git bisect run ./scripts/ci/run_shard.sh 7
```
I'll post updates in-thread.

Alex: Thanks — ping if you need extra VMs or to run on CI infra. If culprit is the base image tag we should open a revert PR and hotfix.

Jon: Update (30m): bisect narrowed the range down to a1b2c3d4..b3d4e5f6. It points to commit 0f9e8d7 from PR #5123 which updates docker base tags. Reproduces locally when launching containers with docker:ubuntu:22.04-base:2026-03-01 image.

Mira: Confirmed locally as well — 0f9e8d7 changes the base tag and adjusts a glibc build flag. I'll open a revert PR and CC infra.

Alex: Plan: Mira opens revert PR, Jon will verify the CI runs green after revert, Paula will prepare release communications if needed. Owners: @Mira (revert), @Jon (verify), @Paula (notify). :white_check_mark:

CI-bot: Re-run triggered after revert merge: build 1815001500 (pending)

Paula: Noted. I'll draft a short note for the Dedicated customers if the image affects downstream artifacts.

Jon: Final update: revert PR #5130 merged, rerun build 1815001500 is green, main CI passing on shard-7. Closing bisect. Thanks everyone. :tada:
